title: docs(adr): ADR-0105 D12 amendment — group posture activation is entitled, not open (#3570)
body:
Founder ruling on the decision flagged in #3559: `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group` is **not** an open-edition feature — ADR-0105's D12 text had it wrong. The code was already corrected by #3570 (`group` probes `org-scoping` exactly like `isolated`; no enterprise runtime ⇒ `single` + `degraded`; an `os serve` boot configured for `group` fail-fasts instead of silently running unwalled). This PR brings the ADR document in line with the corrected decision. Doc-only.

## Changes

- **D12 rewritten** to the code-vs-activation split: the wall's *implementation* ships open (D3/D4 correctness, Layer 0 predicates, D5 stamping/validation, `accessible_org_ids`, D6 lints — same as `isolated`'s wall has always lived in `plugin-security`), while posture *activation* is entitled for **both** multi-org postures. The iron rule (强制免费、治理收费) is satisfied by refusing to run an unwalled `group` boot — open code is not free activation. ADR-0081 D2's commercial line stands.
- **Amendment block** records the original text, why it was wrong (it inverted ADR-0081 D2 by making the stronger posture free while `isolated` stayed entitled, and it opened the silent-degradation hole where `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group` skipped both the enterprise package load and the ADR-0093 D5 fail-fast), and the #3559 → #3570 trail.
- **Consequences** clause updated to match (no more "deliberate commercial concession").
- **Header**: Status → Accepted (proposed 2026-07-25) with the amendment note; Tracking now points at #3541 / #3539 / #3540 / cloud #874 instead of "issue to be filed".

## Verification

- All four repo grep guards clean: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:role-word`, `check:org-identifier`.
- Doc-only diff (1 file, +41/−14); no code, no spec surface.

Follow-up in this session: tracking issue #3541's own "D12 line re-draw" note is being updated to match (issue body edit, not part of this diff).
